purpose: Missing contemporaneous comparison for R70; observational not causal
population: R70 nonfinancial jointly observed members; same industry/period and same complete data for both groups
report: pooled rates across all complete members; within-industry contrasts for R70 coverage gate pass AND >=5 companies in each group; retain all industry records and reasons
standardization: eligible industries weighted by their total joint sample size, same weights for both groups; also equal-industry mean contrast; separately pooled rates on same eligible industries
limits: no causal adjustment for size/selection or investment timing; no p-values for correlated/nested periods and levels; no future returns, model or trading
